# omadafusion_ddns (Resource)

A dynamic DNS client on a WAN port (Services > Dynamic DNS). The controller supports DynDNS, No-IP, PeanutHull and Comexe; Cloudflare is not supported. The password is stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_wan_ports" "this" {}

variable "noip_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "omadafusion_ddns" "office" {
  service     = "noip"
  wan_port_id = data.omadafusion_wan_ports.this.ports[0].id
  username    = "office-it@example.org"
  password    = var.noip_password
  domain      = "office-example.ddns.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Host name to keep updated.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Provider account password.
- `service` (String) One of `dyndns`, `noip`, `peanuthull`, `comexe`.
- `username` (String) Provider account username.
- `wan_port_id` (String) WAN port UUID (see `omadafusion_wan_ports`).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether updates run.
- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `update_interval` (Number) Update interval in minutes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Entry ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <site>/<id>
terraform import omadafusion_ddns.office Default/64f0c0ffee00000000000012
```
